instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Ask a web address for its answer; when the address cannot answer, give back the last answer it gave, so a feed or service that is down does not leave the person with nothing", and give it address (The web address to ask); key (A short name for this answer, so the last good one can be found again); last_answer (the to_keep record it gave last time, once your AI has kept it).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:ask-a-web-address-or-give-the-last-answer and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give address (a web address that starts with http:// or https://) and key (a short name for this answer: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, so the last answer can be found again); wait_seconds (1 to 120, default 20) is how long to wait for the address; last_answer is the answer given back last time.
4. It reads and writes no records. When the address answers, to_keep is the kept-answer record; your AI keeps it with its own records:write and hands it back as last_answer on the next ask.
